mentions.name: Cross-device website productivity blocking
mentions.description: This setup keeps website productivity blockers installed on every browser across all the author's devices and avoids installing news apps, restricting general web browsing and YouTube to non-work days.
mentions.problem: If even one device lacks a blocker, the author feels vulnerable to having hours sucked away by distracting sites.
mentions.source_excerpt: For me, it’s always having website productivity blockers on all my browsers across all my various devices (and for the most part, not installing news apps on any devices either).
